source.source_name: ГФО — Annual Financial Statements (in the Commercial Register)
source.attribution: Източник: Търговски регистър — ГФО (Агенция по вписванията).

access.note: Public per-company filed documents (PDF). No structured open feed. Bulk/automated retrieval may fall under the register's bulk terms; single-document access is public.

pagination.note: Documents attached to the company's register file; located via the register / the 'обявяване на ГФО' publication act. No structured open bulk.

snapshot.note: Persist the PDF; OCR/parse баланс + ОПР. Or consume a commercial provider's structured feed.

parsing.notes: Figures are inside a PDF (Bulgarian, Cyrillic) -> OCR/layout parsing required. Map обща сума на активите->total_assets, собствен капитал->equity, нетни приходи от продажби->revenue, печалба/загуба->net_income. Size category limits disclosure. BGN (EUR from 2026).

mapping_rules.financial_statements: One record per отчетен период; parse баланс + ОПР.
mapping_rules.matching: Clean join on EIK; trigger from the 'обявяване на ГФО' act.

fixture_requirements: голямо/средно company GFO (full баланс + ОПР; revenue present)
микро/малко company GFO (reduced; revenue may be absent)

live_test_plan.smoke: Locate one company's ГФО PDF via the register; OCR/parse total assets + revenue + net result.
live_test_plan.full: For spine entities flagged by an 'обявяване на ГФО' act, fetch the PDFs; OCR/parse to financial_statements[]; OR consume a commercial provider's structured financials (recommended for scale).

blockers: Financials are PDF documents, not structured open data (no XBRL) — OCR/parsing required.
No structured open bulk; commercial provider recommended for scale.
